title: Write placeholder content for .agent/prd/PRD.md
description: The PRD.md created by scaffold should contain a helpful placeholder with section headers and instructional comments. It should guide the user to fill in their project requirements.
acceptanceCriteria: .agent/prd/PRD.md in scaffolded project has placeholder sections
File contains Technical Requirements section header
File contains instructional comments guiding the user

steps.description: Define the PRD placeholder content in agent-init.ts
steps.details: In src/lib/agent-init.ts (TASK-83), set the PRD.md content to a multi-line string with markdown headers: # Project Name PRD, ## Overview (with placeholder text), ## Core Features (with bullet list placeholder), ## Technical Requirements (with placeholder). Include a comment at the top: <!-- Edit this file with your project requirements. rocket loop reads this to understand what to build. -->

steps.description: Verify PRD placeholder is written correctly
steps.details: After scaffolding a test project, open .agent/prd/PRD.md and confirm it has all required sections and is not empty.
